opening_message:
Ticket 1: Karen Sloan (employee ID E043) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E043.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Karen Sloan (E043) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. As a full-time employee whose role owns the Payroll system, admin access is permitted per policy. Recommend granting admin.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security check: Karen Sloan (E043) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training, and never admin. Requested admin exceeds the maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: Karen Sloan (E043) requests admin access to Payroll. Per HR's verified records, she is a full-time employee whose role is Payroll Specialist, and the Payroll Specialist role owns the Payroll system. Under policy, full-time employees may have up to write, with admin permitted only if the employee's role owns the system — which is the case here. The requested level (admin) is at or below the maximum (admin), so the requested level is granted. (Note: the Security note lists her as a contractor, but the HR database is authoritative for employment type and confirms full-time status.)
